newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia trade says wheat bought at $166.87-169.47.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia trade says wheat bought at $166.87-169.47.

text.p: Tunisia purchased five lots of 25,000 tonnes each of soft wheat for April to June shipment at prices ranging from $166.87 to 169.47 per tonne C&F at a tender on Friday, traders told Reuters.
They detailed the purchase as follows:
-20-30 April 25,000 tonnes at $166.96 per tonne C&F
-1-10 May 25,000 tonnes at $168.48 per tonne C&F
-10-20 May 25,000 tonnes at $166.87 per tonne C&F
-20-30 May 25,000 tonnes at $167.90 per tonne C&F
-01-10 June 25,000 tonnes at $169.47 per tonne C&F
